purpose: Defines when two runtime cells are substitutable for a buyer — same product sold at different engines/devices. A price-based routing choice is only legitimate when the arms share a contract that has been measured. Without that, choosing CUDA over Metal on price is choosing a different product on price.

contracts.how_routing_proves_met: A RuntimeDecision that routes among eligible cells must cite this contract id. At verification time every embedding batch is graded under embed-cosine-v2 against the reference (or pairwise against the reference cell's production outputs). A batch that fails mean or row threshold is a different product: timings are void and the outcome is not accepted as substitutable.
contracts.honest_scope: Embed only. Cross-hardware COST comparison remains refused (control/runtime_cell_cost.go:comparableHardwareFor). This contract authorizes quality substitutability, not USD ranking across machines.

contracts.how_routing_proves_met: byte_exact verification against the pinned GGUF artifact (sha256 3f5a2242…). Any cell that cannot reproduce byte-identical greedy decode under the cell's declared batch policy is not on this contract.
contracts.honest_scope: Metal q4 GGUF only. CUDA bf16 HF weights (control/runtime-profiles/vllm-llama-3.2-1b-instruct-bf16.json) are a different precision and a different artifact; they are not eligible under this contract.

contracts.how_routing_proves_met: It cannot. Metal catalogue generation is llama-3.2-1b-instruct-q4 (GGUF Q4_K_M). Catalogue CUDA realtime/vLLM profile is unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct bf16. Token-level agreement on quality-suite is far below identity. Choosing CUDA over Metal on price under this pairing would sell a different product at a different price.
measured_evidence: docs/RUNTIME_AND_PERF.md (vLLM served HF bf16, not pinned GGUF q4 — unfixed)
contracts.honest_scope: What would unblock a generation multi-family contract: (1) a CUDA cell loading the same pinned Q4_K_M GGUF bytes under byte_exact, or (2) a new task-outcome contract (not byte_exact) with explicit metric, threshold, and matched corpus — without weakening verification for buyers who bought byte_exact.
contracts.refusal_reason: Metal q4 versus CUDA bf16 is not one matched quality contract. merc must not rank them on price.
